title: The Worker Recruitment and Protection Act
verified_how: fetched the Manitoba Laws C.C.S.M. index (statutes/index_ccsm.php?lang=en), which lists 'The Worker Recruitment and Protection Act (S.M. 2008, c. 23)' as chapter W197 with a 'Current version (HTML)' link (repealed Acts are held on separate indexes); then fetched the register's legislative-history page statutes/ccsm/_info1act.php?c=W197, which reads 'updated to: September 18, 2026'
notes: Listed rather than recorded as a gap because Manitoba does legislate here: the Act licenses recruiters of foreign workers, registers employers who recruit abroad and bars recruitment fees charged to workers, and it sits alongside the Manitoba Provincial Nominee Program. The work permit and the immigration status themselves remain federal, under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act, S.C. 2001, c. 27, and SOR/2002-227. Manitoba also has The Manitoba Advisory Council on Citizenship, Immigration and Multiculturalism Act, C.C.S.M. c. A6.4, which is advisory only.
